title: Set a home location and show offset differences
body:
The OpenSpec change `set-home-location-and-show-differences` is already prepared in `openspec/changes/set-home-location-and-show-differences/`. Do not create a new change.

**specify:** run the `openspec-propose` procedure against this existing change. It was written before `support-legacy-ios-12-safari` was implemented: re-check every claim about the code against the current `main` (the legacy zone shim, the Pointer Events detection, the bundle budget, the names of the owners in `docs/glossary/`) and update the artifacts. Keep the scope and decisions. Leave it the only active change.

Depends on: `support-legacy-ios-12-safari` (archived).

Goal: README MVP feature 3. The user can mark one location as home or clear it. Every other row shows its offset difference from the reference zone.

Decided:
- Reference zone = the home location's zone ?? the device time zone. It changes only in `getReferenceZone`; the day track, the date bar and date changes follow it.
- The home mark (house icon) takes the leading-mark slot and wins over the Here mark. A row in the device zone that is not home shows the here icon, its difference and the caption «здесь».
- Offset difference uses the design format: `−2 ч` / `−2 h` for whole hours, `+0:30` and `−5:30` with minutes, and `0 ч` for an equal offset with a different zone ID. It is computed on top of `getUtcOffsetMinutes`. Sign, hours and minutes are shared with `formatUtcOffset`, not copied.
- A location menu «⋯» replaces the `×` button. It holds «Сделать домашним» / «Убрать отметку дома» and «Удалить». It opens on click, so it works without Pointer Events (iOS 12), and it adds no new dependency.
- Home is stored with the list: schema v2 with a v1→v2 migration. A stored home that points to a missing location is cleared silently.
- Home is not pinned to the top; reorder works as for any other location.
- Interface text says «место», never «локация».

Docs in this change: glossary entries (Home location, Home mark, Location menu, Offset difference), `views.md`, the ADR-0004 note on clearing a dangling home, `domain-model.md`. README is already updated.

report.question: The task says support-legacy-ios-12-safari is implemented and archived, but in this working copy (base d59c2d5 = main at task creation) it is still an active, unimplemented change: there is no legacy zone shim, Pointer Events detection or bundle budget under packages/client/. Also openspec/changes/ holds 4 active changes (add-wall-time-input-with-hint, show-here-entry-for-device-time, support-legacy-ios-12-safari, set-home-location-and-show-differences). The specify stage may write only inside its own change folder, so it cannot make this the only active change, and the 'exactly one active change' verify check will fail whatever it does. How should I proceed?
options: Wait: rebase the task onto a main where support-legacy-ios-12-safari is implemented and archived and the other changes are archived/removed, then rerun specify

Proceed now: update set-home-location-and-show-differences against the current code (pre-legacy), record support-legacy-ios-12-safari as an unmet dependency/Open Question, and accept that the one-active-change check fails
Proceed now and also allow this stage to remove/archive the other three active changes outside the change folder
